```yaml
name: Claude Code Review

on:
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  issues:
    types: [opened]

jobs:
  claude:
    if: |
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && contains(github.event.comment.body, '@claude')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'issues' && (contains(github.event.issue.body, '@claude') || contains(github.event.issue.title, '@claude')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      id-token: write
      actions: read
    steps:
      - name: Check if user is collaborator
        id: check_collaborator
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            try {
              const { data: permissionLevel } = await github.rest.repos.getCollaboratorPermissionLevel({
                owner: context.repo.owner,
                repo: context.repo.repo,
                username: context.actor
              });
              return permissionLevel.permission === 'admin' || 
                     permissionLevel.permission === 'maintain' || 
                     permissionLevel.permission === 'write';
            } catch (error) {
              // If we can't get permission level, assume not a collaborator
              return false;
            }

      - name: Checkout repository
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      - name: Run Claude Code
        if: steps.check_collaborator.outputs.result == 'true'
        id: claude
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@v1
        with:
          claude_code_oauth_token: ${{ secrets.CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN }}
          additional_permissions: |
            actions: read
```
